sph_interpretive_translation: Any transaction initiated by a drunkard, insane person, distressed individual, addict, minor, elder, or one acting without conscious intent—likewise any act performed without lawful connection—is void in execution and holds no juridical validity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Legal capacity is determined by conscious alignment with Dharma.
Causation: Acts lacking intentional causality have no actionable consequence.
Capacity-based responsibility: Inherent incapacity nullifies juridical liability.
Restoration logic: Invalid acts must be dissolved without residual attribution.
Consciousness alignment: Only acts rooted in awakened awareness hold validity.
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor_status IN [drunk, insane, distressed, addicted, minor, elderly] THEN legal_capacity = FALSE
IF intent_chain = NULL OR unverifiable THEN action_validity = VOID
IF causal_link NOT IN dharma_aligned_framework THEN enforceability = DENY
IF transaction_origin NOT traceable to conscious will THEN adjudication_outcome = DISMISS
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, transactions or actions traced to diminished-capacity actors must be automatically invalidated. The threshold of responsibility requires full cognitive engagement; absence thereof annuls all downstream legal effects.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that only verifiable, conscious agency be recognized in judicial process. Asupūrvaśaḥ (absence of sequential intent) negates liability. Responsibility aligns with capacity, not suffering; hence, no punitive inference arises from invalid acts.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Nullify all derivative contracts or obligations arising from invalid acts.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reassign valid authority to conscious agents within affected domain.
Capacity Restoration: Initiate rehabilitative pathways for impaired individuals to restore functional alignment.
Integrity Reintegration: Reconstruct damaged relational or economic structures through dharmic mediation.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. This Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator. All else is dissolution.
